Bibliography

References cited in CaVeSal® Obstetric Emergencies, grouped by module of the Guides and the Calculator. Each citation is transcribed as it appears in the card where it applies (87 entries).

These are the sources that feed CaVeSal® Obstetric Emergencies, in both its full version and the Demo. The Demo uses the same foundations; only some functions are locked.

3. Bishop score

  • NICE NG207 — Inducing labour (2021): 6 or less, cervical ripening; more than 6, amniotomy and oxytocin. Also used in the calculator (Bishop score card).
  • ACOG Clinical Practice Guideline No. 9 — Cervical ripening in pregnancy. Obstet Gynecol 2025;146(1):148-160: replaces Practice Bulletin 107; there is no universal definition of an unfavorable cervix (studies used cutoffs of 3 to 8).
  • Laughon SK et al. Using a simplified Bishop score to predict vaginal delivery. Obstet Gynecol 2011;117:805-11: simplified Bishop (dilation, effacement, station) more than 5, equivalent to a full Bishop more than 8.
  • StatPearls — Bishop Score (2024): CMQCC ripening targets (6 or more multiparous, 8 or more nulliparous).
